def main():
    MOD = 1000000007
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    if k == 0:
        ans = 1
        for _ in range(1, p):
            ans = (ans * p) % MOD
        print(ans)
        return
    visited = [False] * p
    cycles = 1
    for i in range(1, p):
        if visited[i]:
            continue
        j = (i * k) % p
        visited[i] = True
        while j != i:
            visited[j] = True
            j = (j * k) % p
        cycles = (cycles * p) % MOD
    if k == 1:
        cycles = (cycles * p) % MOD
    print(cycles)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
